channel.title: OutsideClass updates
channel.description: Product news, fixes and learning tips from OutsideClass.

item.title: Your updates, easier to follow
item.description:
Browse product news, fixes and learning tips. Search the feed, copy a link to an update or subscribe through RSS.
OutsideClass AI is now the name of our learning assistant in the interface. It uses Google-hosted Gemma models; questions and consented images are still processed by Google.
The website and RSS feed now come from the same published posts, so readers see the same titles, dates and information in both places.

item.title: One observation. Two possible explanations.
item.description:
Before deciding why something happened, write what you actually noticed and consider a second explanation.
Try describing a leaf, a tile or a shadow without guessing its cause. Then write one possible explanation and another that could also fit what you saw.
Choose one safe observation that could help you tell those explanations apart. If you cannot test them today, save the question for your next visit. This is a learning suggestion, not a report of a completed outdoor lesson.

item.title: A rainy day can still be a learning day
item.description:
Choose a closed window or a seated activity when conditions outside are unsafe.
Select By a window, From a seat and Rainy in Activities. Use a safe indoor view or familiar, unbreakable objects. Keep windows closed and do not lean out.
You can compare shapes or count visible patterns without going outside. An adult should review activities for children; stop if the place or conditions feel unsafe.

item.title: A name for your learning journey
item.description: Choose a nickname and optional role for a personal greeting and notebook label. No login, phone number or code. Profiles stay local, outside AI requests and downloaded work.

item.title: Keep your discoveries safe
item.description: Refreshed offline pages, full-notebook protection, draft preservation, practice results in learner work exports, and clearer small-screen controls.

item.title: Backups, learning checks and image questions
item.description: Back up and restore your notebook with photos, practise with understanding checks, compare discoveries, exchange class packs and optionally ask about selected images with explicit consent.

item.title: Ask your own questions and follow up
item.description: Ask a learning question up to 600 characters. Get an observation activity when it fits, or a direct explanation, and ask a follow-up. Selected topics include external reference-image sources.

item.title: Learning diagrams and your own image attachments
item.description: Supported topics include downloadable learning diagrams. Attach up to two personal photos or sketches from the top of each card and save them locally, even before writing a reflection.

item.title: Return to the same spot with an evidence trail
item.description: Name a spot, record an observation and two possible explanations, then return to check what changed. OutsideClass AI builds a fresh activity from your earlier note.

item.title: A place for your whole learning journey
item.description: Explore dedicated activity, notebook and guide pages. Use the new activity timer with pause, resume and reflection. Group activities, accessible spaces and manual weather choices help fit learning to your day.

item.title: More ways to learn together
item.description: Family and class activities include leader guidance and discussion questions. Choose a seat, window or doorway, and match activities to weather and time of day.

item.title: Three prompts for better reflections
item.description: Record what you noticed, what surprised you and one question you still have. Existing notebook entries remain readable.
